title: Ludgate’s strutter models
content: Dinotopia enthusiast Glenn Ludgate of Australia has been working for a while now on a whole fleet of Dinotopian strutters.These maquettes are all scratch built, and are based on the biologically based vehicles that appear inDinotopia: The World Beneath.Go Glenn!Many of my own original reference maquettes will be exhibited at theLyman Allyn Art Museum show,which opens September 22.
